ISO certification registration online is the seal of approval from the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) that the company meets the international standards for management, manufacturing, or quality. ISO does not issue the certificates; it defines the standards, and external certification organizations carry out audits and award certifications. Some commonly used ISO standards are:
It is a well-defined management system.
